background_story: Gage was a peculiar-looking fish with a distinctive wry mouth, a characteristic that set him apart from the rest of the school. Despite his unusual appearance, he had a unique charm that drew in the other fish. Gage lived in a vibrant coral reef, where he spent most of his days exploring the nooks and crannies. His wry mouth allowed him to feed on the reef's unique delicacies, such as the sweet nectar of the sea anemones. Gage's favorite pastime was playing hide-and-seek among the coral formations, his wry mouth curled into a perpetual smirk as he dodged and weaved through the wavy sea fans. The other fish admired his carefree spirit and agility, and Gage became a beloved fixture in the reef community, known for his quirky appearance and infectious enthusiasm.
